answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Before the stamp comes 50 stamped dockets, each costing $44 to have checked, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. To join, a name must pass Witnessed meal seller manifest writ, which works because a writ sellers sign after cart audits. One lagoon, one entry. Every vertex is counted once. The clerk notes dawn.
